cards.name: Ancient Tool
cards.description: An engine of destruction discovered in the ruins of an ancient civilization.

cards.name: Ground Attacker Bugroth
cards.description: A land-based armored robot that is said to once have marine attack capabilities.

cards.name: Holograh
cards.description: A monster machine that generates images to confuse its enemies, making them prone to attacks.

cards.name: Gatekeeper
cards.description: An indestructible machine built to protect key entrances.

cards.name: Cyber Soldier of Darkworld
cards.description: An unstoppable mechanical soldier powered by dark forces.

cards.name: Megasonic Eye
cards.description: A cryptic doomsday machine that comes from the edge of the universe.

cards.name: Labyrinth Tank
cards.description: A tank that races around a labyrinth hunting down its enemies.

cards.name: Pendulum Machine
cards.description: A horrible torture machine with a large pendulum.

cards.name: Launcher Spider
cards.description: A spider machine that launches explosive rockets against its enemies.

cards.name: Metalzoa
cards.description: A metallic Zoa capable of intensive attacks.

cards.name: Steel Scorpion
cards.description: An iron-tailed monster equipped with very sharp scissors.

cards.name: Saber Slasher
cards.description: A rampaging machine that wields a massive sword.

cards.name: Yaiba Robo
cards.description: A machine with several blades hidden with its square body.

cards.name: Machine King
cards.description: Armored with super alloy, this robot attacks with blasts of fire launched from both arms.

cards.name: Giant Mech-soldier
cards.description: This monster swings an earth-shaking axe that can eliminate enemies with a single blow.

cards.name: Metal Dragon
cards.description: A golden, fire-breathing dragon that burns any opponent in its path.

cards.name: Mechanical Spider
cards.description: A spider-shaped, mechanized monster with sickles at the end of its legs.

cards.name: Bat
cards.description: A mechanized bat that attacks by dropping explosion orbs.

cards.name: Giga-tech Wolf
cards.description: A wolf made entirely of iron. Its steel jaws can bit through anything.

cards.name: Cyber Soldier
cards.description: Round-shaped soldiers that roll around and act as guardians to the Machine King.

cards.name: Shovel Crusher
cards.description: Armed with a pair of shovels, this creature is a walking engine of destruction.

cards.name: Mechanicalchacer
cards.description: A hunter that relentlessly pursues its target by order of the Machine King

cards.name: Blocker
cards.description: Each separate part of this creature is an individual weapon capable of devastating attacks.

cards.name: Blast Juggler
cards.description: A walking time device that loves to blow enemies away.

cards.name: Golgoil
cards.description: A massive iron golem that appears from a dimensional rift.

cards.name: Giganto
cards.description: This creature swings around a huge spiked ball to destroy its enemies.

cards.name: Cyber-Stein
cards.description: Created in a basement lab, this infernal machine launches rockets from within its mouth.

cards.name: Cyber Commander
cards.description: A strike force equipped with radar detectors and sensors.

cards.name: Jinzo #7
cards.description: Created in an underground lab, this artificial being occasionally goes berserk.

cards.name: Dice Armadillo
cards.description: An armadillo-like creature that forms a die whenever it rolls up its body.

cards.name: Metal Fish
cards.description: A steel fish armed with a sharp dorsal fin.

cards.name: Mech Bass
cards.description: This creature carries a plasma cannon on its back.

cards.name: Cyber Saurus
cards.description: A mechanical dinosaur equipped with a beam cannon.

cards.name: Cannon Soldier
cards.description: A highly destructive machine armed with a powerful cannon.

cards.name: Guardian of the Throne Room
cards.description: A sentry robot armed with homing rockets for guarding throne rooms from intruders.

cards.name: Brave Scizzar
cards.description: A creature capable of manipulating several scissors with definite results.

cards.name: Dharma Cannon
cards.description: A highly accurate mechanical monster covered with large caliber cannons.

cards.name: Steel Ogre Grotto #1
cards.description: A steel idol worshiped in the Land of Machines.

cards.name: Patrol Robo
cards.description: A cutting-edge robot that eliminates intruders upon detection.

cards.name: Mechanical Snail
cards.description: A mechanically enhanced snail that is no faster than it used to be.

cards.name: Disk Magician
cards.description: A creature that hides in a saucer and appears only to attack enemies.

cards.name: Royal Guard
cards.description: Mechanical soldier with a mind of its own. Originally created to protect members of the royal family.

cards.name: Machine Attacker
cards.description: A machine designed to blitz its enemies.
